messages:
morgan: Quick check — planning a dry-run of the KV-cache migration runbook tomorrow 09:30 PT. I noticed one of the links in the runbook 404s (s3://kb/runbooks/kv-cache.md). Who owns this doc? Can someone claim and also skim the runbook for step timing? /cc @jordan @yasmin

jordan: I can take the ownership check. Which link is 404ing?

morgan: Top of the page under 'preflight checks' — the curl example points to https://internal.kb/runtime/curl-example.md and that returns 404 when I open it in staging.

yasmin: Hmm that file was moved during the docs cleanup last week. I can either rehost the snippet in the runbook or update the link to the shortlink (/kb/runtime-curl). Which do you prefer?

morgan: Prefer updating to the shortlink, small PR is ideal. Also could someone run a quick anchor/fragment scan on the page? Want to avoid missing anchors that break automation.

docs-bot: anchor-scan: found 1 broken external link, 2 orphan anchors. Full report: https://reports.internal/scan/9251234567 (auto-generated)

sam: I'll run a dry-run on staging tomorrow at 09:30 PT. Can we freeze edits to the runbook until 09:15 PT so the runbook I run against matches what's in docs/main?

jordan: I'll open a PR right now to update the curl link to /kb/runtime-curl and add a tiny note about the --max-time caveat. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/4321

morgan: Nice — also can we add a short 'rollback sanity' checklist item? We missed a step last time and it cost extra time. If someone sketches 3 bullets I can fold them into the PR.

yasmin: On it — pushing a commit to the PR with rollback bullets and a one-line rationale.

sam: :eyes: I'll hold edits until after 09:15 PT and then run the staging dry-run. I'll comment any timing adjustments in the PR (e.g., wait for cache-warm vs KV-migrate timings).

deploy-bot: deploy-notify: staging deploy scheduled at 2026-03-22T09:20:00Z for branch docs/kv-fix (automated)

morgan: Perfect. Plan: 1) merge the link fix PR, 2) merge rollback bullets, 3) run the dry-run at 09:30 PT. Thanks everyone. If anything else pops up, drop it as a PR comment or ping here. :thumbsup:

jordan: merged the link fix into a fast-follow commit, will keep the PR open for rollback bullets. (reaction :shipit: by jordan)

yasmin: committed rollback bullets, updated the changelog entry at the top of the runbook.

sam: Dry-run complete on staging — left two small timing notes in PR comments (cache-warm 45s -> 60s, KV migrate parallelism -> 4). No additional broken links found after the fix.

morgan: Awesome, looks good. I'll schedule the prod run for Monday once we confirm Dedicated capacity window. Closing this thread — thanks all.
